projects.name: OfflinePay
projects.stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Supabase, BLE
projects.description: A checkpoint-based mechanism for bounding merchant risk in offline peer-to-peer mesh payments. Uses bank-signed sequence checkpoints and local state to reduce transaction limits as checkpoints are missed.

projects.name: NirmanCheck
projects.stack: Python, Signal Processing, Accelerometer, FFT, ML
projects.description: A vibration-based preliminary screening concept for construction materials. Compares measured vibration fingerprints with validated samples to flag normal, suspicious or retest outcomes.

projects.description: A wearable pre-screening prototype concept combining temperature measurements and pressure mapping. Intended as an exploratory screening aid, not a diagnostic device.
